results.title: [PDF] International Students Becoming Physiotherapist - Sign in
results.content: There is very little research which examines this directly, so I draw on literature around the professional development of student physiotherapists whose learning takes place in their country of origin, and literature around the professional development of ‘international’ students engaged in health related degrees, whose education is based in a university and includes practice placements in clinical settings. To synthesise findings into tangible recommendations for physiotherapy education 263 A focused exploration of individual students’ narratives (of their perceptions and experiences) during their course, will aim to increase understandings of the factors that influence students’ transition to studying in the UK and their overall professional development (including formal learning on campus and on clinical placement and informal development). In addition, this research aims to contribute to the wider evidence base relating to the education of international students on health-related courses which include professional experience placements and more specifically, to curriculum development and staff development at Coventry University.
